name: Floating each
pattern: Clause[plural participant NP + separately positioned each]

entry.name: Floating each
entry.pattern: Clause[plural participant NP + separately positioned each]

1.definition: Distributes the predication over individual members associated with a nearby argument.

examples.form: The three hikers [each carried a radio].

projection.target: Each can follow the subject across a finite auxiliary in The hikers had each carried a radio. The linked NP can have its own determiner and is not contained in each.
projection.evidence: See the cited discussion and the constructed illustration.

curious.title: Each, placed away from its group
curious.summary: The word each can sit after a group of people or things and say the action applies to every member separately.
curious.body: In The three hikers each carried a radio, each isn't stuck to a noun. It sits later and says the carrying applies to the hikers one by one: every hiker carried a radio. The word can follow the subject even across a helper verb, as in The hikers had each carried a radio. The group it's linked to can have its own the, and the group isn't contained inside each.

examples.text: The three hikers [each carried a radio].
The hikers had [each carried a radio].
The two sisters [each wrote a letter].

curious.try: Say The three hikers each carried a radio. Then say Each of the hikers carried a radio. Is the meaning the same?

teacher.summary: Helps explain floating each, which distributes an action over the members of a nearby plural noun phrase.
teacher.explain: Floating each is separately positioned from the plural participant NP it is associated with, and it distributes the predication over the individual members: The three hikers each carried a radio. Each can follow the subject across a finite auxiliary, as in The hikers had each carried a radio. The linked NP can have its own determiner and isn't contained in each. This dictionary relates the pattern to the each-of partitive and to each in subject determiner function, and marks it provisional, with medium confidence.
teacher.terms: Each in this position is sometimes called a floating quantifier. Distributive each is used for its meaning.

examples.text: The three hikers [each carried a radio].
The hikers had [each carried a radio].

contrasts.text: The three hikers each carried a radio.
contrasts.note: Each sits away from the group it distributes over.

contrasts.text: Each of the hikers carried a radio.
contrasts.note: Each heads a partitive and is next to the group.

watch_for: A learner might read each as modifying radio rather than distributing over the hikers.
A learner might think each has to sit right next to its subject.
teacher.activity: Students write sentences about a group (the three hikers, two sisters) and place each in different spots, before and after a helper verb. They check that it still distributes over the group.
